From today, Runna subscribers can use the brand-new "Adapt for Heat" feature, which automatically adjusts pace targets based on local temperature and humidity. Details are as follows.

Runna adds heat-aware training tool

The personal running coach app Runna announced three updates today, designed to support users throughout their entire training cycle — from training in hot weather to post-race recovery.

The "Adapt for Heat" feature launching from today helps users identify cooler running times and recommends adjusted pace targets based on felt air temperature, training duration, and specific sessions.

The "Adapt for Heat" feature includes color-coded hourly weather forecasts, allowing users to quickly find the most suitable time slots for running and plan accordingly.

Runna shared the following about this new feature:

Runna also announced the relaunch of its "Post-Race Recovery Plan" feature — once a user opens a race plan for 5K to 50K events, the system will automatically build a recovery plan for them. These plans are designed by professional coaches and can help runners "reduce the risk of burnout or injury," said Steph Kessell, Runna's head coach and former Olympian.

Finally, the platform announced it will launch a brand-new feature called "Upcoming Plans" in August. Users can schedule multiple training plans in advance and automatically transition from one plan to the next upon completion, further simplifying long-term training management.

Runna explained the advantages of "Upcoming Plans" as follows:

Plan your entire year of training in minutes: Runners can stack races, transition goals, and training phases, giving a clear overview of the whole year. Zero admin between plans: No need to rebuild or start from scratch — preferred training schedules, projected race times, and current performance levels are automatically carried over to the next plan when the current one ends. Flexibility and full control: Every plan can be edited, swapped, or deleted at any time, so runners remain fully in control of their training experience. Built for progress: Every plan is designed by Runna's senior coaches based on established training principles to support sustainable progress, recovery, and race-day preparation.
